purpose: Development/demo first-PA video connection; no new held-out performance claim.
source_access: Ordinary HTTPS GET of public official pages and the exact public MP4 sources advertised in their video elements; no authentication or restriction bypass.
identity_method: gamePk + atBatIndex+1 + explicit pitchNumber + exact playId, corroborated by official Savant page player IDs, matchup, date, pitch type, speed, and count; not list-order pairing.

media.rendition_source: The single MP4 source directly advertised in the public Savant page video element; no alternate rendition inferred.

poster.selection: First decoded video frame at/after the requested zero-second seek; original video stream starts at 0.013000 seconds.

visual_review.method: Assistant inspection of decoded still frames; not human inter-rater agreement or OCR validation.
visual_review.initial_frame_observation: Pre-pitch setup, KING 34 jersey visible. Main CHC/SD scorebug has not appeared, so initial 0-0 count and inning are not visually readable. Top-right BOS/NYY graphic concerns another game.
visual_review.later_frame_observation: At 3.2s batter holds the bat while pitch passes, and 4s shows receipt without swing. Main scorebug at 4s shows CHC 0, SD 0, top 1, no outs, bases empty, count 0-0. At 6.7s it shows CROW-ARMSTRONG and SINKER 96 MPH but count still 0-0 (display delay). Official page/feed supply Called Strike; still-frame sampling alone does not independently prove the umpire call.
visual_review.use_limitations: Identity is bound through exact page playId and explicit feed PA/pitch IDs with corroborating game/player/type/speed metadata, supplemented by visual frames. No timing is derived from feed UTC; no mitt or target coordinates were assigned.
